fact: ANSD's illicit financial flows pilot (SDG 16.4.1) ran a collection workshop on 4-8 August 2025 collecting raw data from Customs (DGD) and Tax Authorities (DGID), then a finalisation workshop on 13-17 October 2025, after methodological training on 10-12 February 2025.
title: Technical Note: Measuring Illicit Financial Flows in Senegal
